create_Simulator_subclass: create a subclass of Simulator that overrides terminal, get_key, and set_key for a custom game environment
implement_Simulator_get_key: implement the get_key method in a Simulator subclass to return the encoded state of the game
implement_Simulator_set_key: implement the set_key method in a Simulator subclass to set actions from agent replies
override_Simulator_restart: override the restart method in a Simulator subclass to reset the game environment state
run_Simulator_loop: run the Simulator main loop that sends game data via ZMQ and waits for agent replies
